You won't beat the game right away. So, Play, Learn, Explore. Try to beat your personal best (/stats) and eventually compete for the top of the leaderboard.

ff.messages.info.tutorial_message.hard_t: And hard tasks are just straight up puzzles. Good luck.

ff.info.fossil_frights.1.title: ǫᴜɪᴄᴋ sᴛᴀʀᴛ
ff.info.fossil_frights.1.content:
1. Press Start Game to begin your first shift.

2. Go to the bookshelf and read your task book.

3. Finish every task before the five-minute shift ends.

4. When all tasks are complete, return to the start room and press Next Day to continue.
ff.info.fossil_frights.2.title: ʜᴏᴡ ᴛᴏ ᴘʟᴀʏ
ff.info.fossil_frights.2.content:
You are a night-shift security guard in a museum. Each shift gives you a set of tasks, and you have five minutes to complete them.

The task book gives you the most important clues, but it will not explain the whole museum. Explore, learn the rooms, and remember useful routes.

You are not expected to win on your first try. Set a personal best, keep learning, and try to survive all 10 days.
ff.info.fossil_frights.3.content.1: Easy tasks usually require going somewhere, pressing a button, or checking a specific part of the museum.
ff.info.fossil_frights.3.content.2: Medium tasks are trickier and always require an item. Use your Storage Key to retrieve items, often from the basement, then bring each item to the location named in the task book.
ff.info.fossil_frights.3.content.3: Hard tasks are puzzles. Read the hints carefully, explore, and expect each one to work differently.
ff.info.fossil_frights.4.title: ʜᴀᴢᴀʀᴅ ꜰɪxᴇs
ff.info.fossil_frights.4.content:
Lights Out: pull the breaker to restore the lights.

Floor is Lava: reset the lava boiler to clean up the spill.

Flood: turn the water shutoff valve.

Curse: reset the ghost force field to repel the curse.

Security Gates: reset the security controller in the security office.
ff.info.fossil_heists.1.title: ʜᴏᴡ ᴛᴏ ᴘʟᴀʏ
ff.info.fossil_heists.1.content: Thieves try to steal $1000 worth of merchandise while guards continuously stop them during a 10-minute night shift.
ff.info.fossil_heists.2.title: ɢᴜᴀʀᴅꜱ
ff.info.fossil_heists.2.content:
Use a series of items: a night stick for killing, an ice cannon for freezing, plus glow traps and cameras for finding the thieves.

Guards are shown a list of all available items on the sidebar. Entries flash red if stolen and are crossed out if captured.

If less than $1000 of loot is stolen before 10 minutes is up, the guards win.
ff.info.fossil_heists.3.title: ᴛʜɪᴇᴠᴇꜱ
ff.info.fossil_heists.3.content:
The thieves start in the vent. Review the sidebar list and try to steal at least $1000 of loot by collecting it and bringing it to the capture point at the museum entry.

On death, thieves lose any items they are carrying.

If thieves punch a guard, they are given a key and coin plus a short amount of invisibility to escape.
ff.info.fossil_heists.4.title: ʟᴏᴏᴛ
ff.info.fossil_heists.4.content:
All loot locations are specified in the loot book.

Common loot is just 1 click to get.

Uncommon loot requires a key stolen from the guards, then that key must be used on a lock to get loot from the basement or elsewhere.

Rare loot usually requires an item from the basement and a little extra work, such as visiting an anvil.

Heavy loot is also 1 click to grab, but it applies extra slowness.
ff.info.fossil_heists.5.title: ʜᴀᴢᴀʀᴅꜱ
ff.info.fossil_heists.5.content:
The hazards are the same as the base game, but in heists they can be activated by the thieves, either manually or by eating a Hazard Cookie.

Hazards give buffs to thieves, such as disabling cameras, revealing traps, or granting potion effects.

ff.settings.mode.party.title: Party Mode
ff.settings.mode.party.body:
Party mode opens the museum doors, letting players join and leave the game freely.

Recommended for players who have beaten the game, or large groups on a call, as there's only one task book and it's easy to miss learning the content.
ff.settings.mode.heists.title: Fossil Heists
ff.settings.mode.heists.body:
Fossil Heists is a two-team gamemode where Guards must find and stop Thieves from stealing loot before the 10-minute night shift ends.

Recommended for players who know the museum layout and the base-game mechanics.
